candidates.description: This feature vector represents linguistic roots and suffixes related to political concepts of freedom, stability, and suppression.
This vector is related to grammatical prepositions indicating location, time, or relation across multiple languages.
These tokens represent French adverbs of frequency, degree, and logical connection used to modify verbs and clauses.
These tokens are common English suffixes and suffix-heavy word endings, particularly nominalizing suffixes like "-ation" and "-ative."
This vector activates for common suffixes and endings of feminine adjectives and nouns in Romance languages.
This vector represents potential risks, problems, or threatening situations.
These tokens represent common French words or word segments following an apostrophe, such as elided articles or prepositions.
This feature vector represents concepts related to violence, tragedy, controversy, and accusations.
This feature vector represents noun- and adverb-forming derivational suffixes ending in "ment" across various spellings and pluralizations.
This feature activates on prefixes, roots, and spelling variations related to automobiles, vehicles, and the French word "auto."
